training_config.status: Predeclared architecture-capacity candidate B (see configs/model1/candidate_architectures.json). Identical to the approved baseline training_config.json in every respect except model.hidden_size/model.latent_size -- architecture capacity is the sole experimental variable in this comparison.

model.note: Candidate B architecture size from configs/model1/candidate_architectures.json -- num_layers/dropout unchanged from baseline (1 / 0.0).

loss.name: mean_squared_error
loss.note: Reconstruction MSE between model output and input window, per the locked protocol (M1 is an autoencoder trained on known-normal windows only).

optimizer.name: Adam
optimizer.note: Conventional initial value (1e-3) for Adam. UNTUNED -- a reasonable starting point, not chosen through any experiment.

training_config.batch_size_note: Reasonable starting value given 4,020 training windows (~63 batches/epoch). UNTUNED.
training_config.max_epochs_note: Finite upper bound. Actual training will very likely stop earlier via early stopping.

early_stopping.note: Based ONLY on validation reconstruction loss (MSE on known-normal validation windows) -- never on any threshold-derived metric (F1, detection delay, pre-fault FPR), which are explicitly out of scope for this phase.

checkpoint_selection.rule: save the checkpoint from the epoch with the lowest val_reconstruction_loss seen so far
checkpoint_selection.note: Selection uses validation reconstruction loss only -- no anomaly threshold or labeled metric is computed or used anywhere in this phase.

seed.note: Fixed training seed (Python random, NumPy, PyTorch) controlling model initialization and any training-time shuffling. Intentionally a separate, independent value from configs/model1/split_seed.json's seed (298), which governs the data split and is unrelated to training reproducibility.

validation_data_usage_this_phase.note: Threshold selection is a separate, later phase after the reconstruction model is frozen, per protocol_config.json's labeling.window_prediction_rule.

window_regions.training_region: t < 360 (known-normal region), train-split cases only, stride 5 -- scripts/model1/data/dataset.py build_train_windows()
window_regions.model_selection_validation_region: t < 360 (known-normal region), val-split cases only, stride 1 -- scripts/model1/data/dataset.py build_model_selection_validation_windows(). Used ONLY for val_reconstruction_loss, early stopping, and best-checkpoint selection. Because M1 is a one-class normal-behavior reconstruction model, model-selection must never see post-injection windows.
window_regions.threshold_selection: separate later phase, using the FULL pre/post timeline of the validation split (stride 1) via build_eval_windows() -- NOT performed in this phase, and this training path never builds or loads those windows.
window_regions.test_region: not loaded by the training path at all, in this phase or any other.

training_config.test_split_usage_this_phase: NEVER loaded by the training path.
training_config.missing_value_policy: See configs/model1/protocol_config.json normalization.missing_value_policy. Summary: raw NaN in a locked feature -> imputed with that feature's training-only committed scaler mean, before scaling, so it becomes 0.0 in standardized space. Discovered necessary after run baseline_seed42_h64_z32 diverged to NaN; this is a preprocessing correction, not a tuning decision.
